data.title: 八重神子 · 鸣神大社的狐影醉卧
data.action: 慵懒斜卧在神樱树下的朱红回廊榻榻米上，单手托腮，修长白皙的食指挑逗般绕着粉色狐耳下的垂穗耳坠，紫眸微眯，尽显宫司大人的倾城媚态。
data.location: 影向山鸣神大社最高殿宇回廊，古老神樱树在夜空中散落万千发光花瓣
data.timeOfDay: 月上中天微风拂樱之刻
data.lighting: 神樱树散发的荧光粉紫微光与满月清霜交融，在朱红回廊与白皙如雪的胴体上流淌
data.mood: 千年狐妖的极度从容与玩世不恭，兼具神圣威仪与惊心动魄的肉食系诱惑
data.description: 影向山鸣神大社最高殿宇回廊，古老神樱树在夜空中散落万千发光花瓣。慵懒斜卧在神樱树下的朱红回廊榻榻米上，单手托腮，修长白皙的食指挑逗般绕着粉色狐耳下的垂穗耳坠，紫眸微眯，尽显宫司大人的倾城媚态。 她微微抬眸轻语——“哎呀呀……小家伙，这么晚偷偷溜进大社后院，是想要向本宫司祈求签文呢，还是……祈求本宫司自己呢？”
data.promptProse: In a full-body wide view along the vermilion wooden veranda of the mountaintop shrine beneath the glowing Sacred Sakura and full moon, Yae Miko lounges beside a lacquer sake cup playing with her pendant earring and watching the visitor with amused, teasing poise.
data.animaCaption: Reclining languidly across the lacquered Grand Narukami Shrine veranda beneath swirling glowing sakura petals and a bright full moon, she props her chin in one hand and toys with her tassel earring with a sly teasing smirk in a scarlet-and-white kimono-cut silk slip robe parted high along her bare legs.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a scarlet-and-white silk kimono-cut slip robe with sheer flowing peignoir sleeves, a red sacred cord knotted across her cleavage, and a waist-high open slit baring her legs.
